caption: The drawing depicts a round, shallow bowl with a wide rim, viewed from above. The bowl is primarily dark brown or black in color, with a glossy appearance suggesting a glazed surface. A pattern of thick, wavy yellowish-brown lines winds irregularly across the interior of the bowl, forming interconnected loops and curves. The rim of the bowl features a repeating scalloped or wavy pattern in similar yellowish-brown tones. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color, with no additional objects or decorations present. There is a small signature in the lower right corner outside the bowl.
title: Pa. German Dish
